in_hebrew.name: Garsenda
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shepherdess of the Army
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Garsenda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Garsenda was a shepherdess who was also a warrior. She protected her flock from danger and led her soldiers into battle. Her name is derived from the Greek words 'agros' meaning countryside and 'hendeia' meaning strength or power.
